name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a royalty and streaming company focused on gold properties in Nevada. Rather than operating mines directly, the company acquires royalties and exploration stream agreements on smaller producing and pre-production properties, including a 3% Net Smelter Royalty and Exploration Stream Earn-in at the Lapon Canyon Project. The company is headquartered in Reno, Nevada and was incorporated in 2014.
